titel: 'Super Movers’ Have Better Brain Health. Are You One?

einzeiler: A 91-year-old sets a hiking record, and new research links mobility to brain health.
kurzfassung: A North American river otter has been spotted on the Bronx River for the first time in about a century, signaling successful restoration efforts. Meanwhile, a nonprofit provides free accessible vacations for families with children who have disabilities, and a 91-year-old hiker becomes the oldest person to complete the Appalachian Trail. Additionally, a new study highlights the link between faster walking speeds in older adults and better cognitive health.
stichpunkte: A North American river otter was spotted on the Bronx River in New York City, marking the first documentation there in about a century and highlighting freshwater ecosystem recovery.
Christian and Tom Perso founded the nonprofit Cherry Blossom Vacations to provide free, accessible holiday stays for families with children who have disabilities and foster or adopted children.
Sean Moss has run a barbershop in Murfreesboro, Tennessee, offering free back-to-school haircuts to students for over three decades.
A 300-year-old oak tree in South Carolina stands as a rare surviving witness tree of the 1781 Battle of Utah Springs during the American Revolutionary War.
Pop star Olivia Rodrigo's Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival raised $10 million, which was doubled to $20 million through a match from philanthropist Melinda French Gates.
Dale Sanders, known as Graybeard, became the oldest person at age 91 to through-hike the Appalachian Trail.
A study published in Neurology identified 'super movers'—adults in their 80s who walk significantly faster than their peers and show a lower likelihood of developing cognitive impairment.
beschreibung:
Families with children with disabilities can have a lot to consider when traveling – this nonprofit is helping make it easier. Meet a Revolutionary War witness that’s still standing hundreds of years later. And after decades of trying to clean up the Bronx River, conservationists just got a pretty adorable sign that it’s paying off. One barber is easing the cost of back-to-school season by giving students free haircuts. Plus, a 91-year-old just broke a major hiking record – and what science tells us about staying active as we age.

Host/Producer: Krista Bo Polanco

Producer: Eryn Mathewson

Senior Producer: Felicia Patinkin
